mapper.update: /*setBntTrxlBuRqItemInfoReg*/ INSERT INTO BNTTRXL ( DOC_NAME , TARGET , KEY_1 , KEY_2 , KEY_3 , KEY_4 , KEY_5 , KEY_6 , KEY_7 , KEY_8 , KEY_9 , KEY_10 , KEY_11 , KEY_12 , KEY_13 , KEY_14 , KEY_15 , KEY_16 , KEY_17 , KEY_18 , KEY_19 , KEY_20 , KEY_21 , KEY_22 , KEY_23 , KEY_24 ) VALUES ( 'BURQ_INFO', -- DOC_NAME #{USER_ID}, -- TARGET USER_ID #{st_burq_no}, -- KEY_1 BURQ_NO #{SEQ}, -- KEY_2 NVL(#{ITEM_KEY_ID}, ' '), -- KEY_3 NVL(#{SM_DESCRIPTION},' '), -- KEY_4 NVL(#{SM_SPECIFICATION}, ' '), -- KEY_5 NVL(#{SM_MAKER_PART_NO}, ' '), -- KEY_6 NVL(#{SM_MAKER_CODE}, ' '), -- KEY_7 NVL((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M104' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE = #{SM_MAKER_CODE}), ' '), -- KEY_8 NVL(#{SM_MIN_ORDER_QTY}, ' '), -- KEY_9 NVL(#{SM_PUR_UNIT_QTY}, ' '), -- KEY_10 NVL(#{SM_UNIT_MEASURE}, ' '), -- KEY_11 ' ', -- KEY_12 ' ', -- KEY_13 ' ', -- LEY_14 ' ', -- KEY_15 ' ', -- KEY_16 ' ', -- KEY_17 ' ', -- KEY_18 ' ', -- KEY_19 ' ', -- KEY_20 ' ', -- KEY_21 ' ', -- KEY_22 ' ', -- KEY_23 ' ' -- KEY_24 )
mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpRqBulkQuotationItemInfoReg*/ SELECT SEQ, ITEM_KEY_ID, DESCRIPTION, SM_DESCRIPTION, SM_SPECIFICATION, SM_MAKER_PART_NO, SM_MAKER_CODE, SM_MAKER_NAME, SM_MIN_ORDER_QTY, SM_PUR_UNIT_QTY, SM_UNIT_MEASURE, CASE WHEN STATUS = 'K2' THEN '견적마감' WHEN DESCRIPTION IS NULL THEN '키값 오류' WHEN SM_DESCRIPTION IS NULL AND SM_SPECIFICATION IS NULL AND SM_MAKER_PART_NO IS NULL AND SM_MAKER_CODE IS NULL AND SM_MAKER_NAME IS NULL AND SM_MIN_ORDER_QTY IS NULL AND SM_PUR_UNIT_QTY IS NULL AND SM_UNIT_MEASURE IS NULL THEN '필수정보 누락' WHEN UNIT_FLAG = 'N' THEN '단위 오류' WHEN IS_NUMBER(SM_MIN_ORDER_QTY) != 0 THEN '최소주문수량 오류' WHEN IS_NUMBER(SM_PUR_UNIT_QTY) != 0 THEN '주문배수수량 오류' ELSE '정상' END AS RESULT FROM ( SELECT KEY_2 AS SEQ, KEY_3 AS ITEM_KEY_ID, TRIM(KEY_4) AS SM_DESCRIPTION, TRIM(KEY_5) AS SM_SPECIFICATION, TRIM(KEY_6) AS SM_MAKER_PART_NO, TRIM(KEY_7) AS SM_MAKER_CODE, TRIM(KEY_8) AS SM_MAKER_NAME, TRIM(KEY_9) AS SM_MIN_ORDER_QTY, TRIM(KEY_10) AS SM_PUR_UNIT_QTY, TRIM(KEY_11) AS SM_UNIT_MEASURE, (SELECT MAX(KEP_DESCRIPTION) FROM KEP_BURQ_RFQ RFQ WHERE RFQ.BURQ_NO = KEY_1 AND RFQ.ITEM_KEY_ID = KEY_3) AS DESCRIPTION, (SELECT MAX(STATUS) FROM KEP_BURQ_RFQ RFQ WHERE RFQ.BURQ_NO = KEY_1 AND RFQ.ITEM_KEY_ID = KEY_3) AS STATUS, DECODE( TRIM(KEY_11), NULL, 'Y', DECODE( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE IN (SELECT COM_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE BYCA_COMORG_CODE = SUBSTR(KEY_3, 10)) AND CODE = TRIM(KEY_1) AND TYPE = 'UNIT' AND FLAG = 'Y'), 0, DECODE( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M007' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE = KEY_11), 0 ,'N', 'Y') ) ) AS UNIT_FLAG FROM BNTTRXL A WHERE A.DOC_NAME = 'BURQ_INFO' AND A.TARGET = #{USER_ID} AND A.KEY_1 = #{st_burq_no} ) ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(SEQ)
mapper.update: /*updateMasterMpRqBulkQuotationItemInfoReg*/ MERGE INTO KEP_BURQ_RFQ USING BNTTRXL ON (KEY_1 = BURQ_NO AND KEY_3 = ITEM_KEY_ID AND DOC_NAME = 'BURQ_INFO' AND TARGET = #{USER_ID} AND KEY_1 = #{st_burq_no}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET SM_DESCRIPTION = NVL(TRIM(KEY_4),SM_DESCRIPTION), SM_SPECIFICATION = NVL(TRIM(KEY_5),SM_SPECIFICATION), SM_MAKER_PART_NO = NVL(TRIM(KEY_6),SM_MAKER_PART_NO), SM_MAKER_CODE = NVL(TRIM(KEY_7),SM_MAKER_CODE), SM_MIN_ORDER_QTY = NVL(TRIM(KEY_9),SM_MIN_ORDER_QTY), SM_PUR_UNIT_QTY = NVL(TRIM(KEY_10),SM_PUR_UNIT_QTY), SM_UNIT_MEASURE = NVL(TRIM(KEY_11),SM_UNIT_MEASURE), CHANGE_DATE = SYSDATE, CHANGE_USER_ID = #{USER_ID}
